items.title: Monohybrid cross, us ki tashreeh aur testcross (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the monohybrid cross, its interpretation and the testcross, block for block (PDF 85-86).

blocks.text: Apne tajurbon se Mendel ne yeh nateeja nikala ke har do mukhalif khasiyaton ke jore mein se aik khasiyat F1 hybrids mein nazar nahi aati, lekin F2 ke 1/4 beejon mein wapas aa jati hai. Is ka matlab hai ke jo khasiyat 'ghayab' hui thi woh F1 beejon mein chhupi hui thi.

blocks.alt: Upar se neeche silsila. Homozygous gol beej (RR) aur homozygous jhurridar beej (rr) se matar ke paude ugte hain; gol beej wale paude ke stamens nikal diye jate hain aur doosre paude se pollen us tak laye jate hain. Gametes banne par maada gamete R aur nar gamete r milte hain aur F1 ke heterozygous gol beej (Rr) bante hain. F1 paude ki self pollination se maada gametes R, r aur nar gametes R, r bante hain jo mil kar F2 beej RR, Rr, Rr aur rr dete hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar se neeche parhein: RR (gol) aur rr (jhurridar) paudon ke gametes R aur r mil kar F1 mein sirf Rr (gol) dete hain. Phir F1 paudha self-pollinate hota hai: is ke female gametes R ya r aur male gametes R ya r hote hain. Inhein milane se F2 mein RR, Rr, Rr aur rr bante hain: 3/4 gol aur 1/4 jhurridar.
Nataij ki wazahat (Interpretation of the Results)

Mendel ne samjhaya ke jandaron ki khasiyatein (characters ya traits) khaas 'factors' control karte hain, jinhein aaj genes kehte hain. Har fard diploid hai, yaani us ke paas har khasiyat ke do genes hote hain. Genes chromosomes par hote hain. Jab fard haploid gametes (eggs ya sperms) banata hai to har gamete ko har khasiyat ka sirf aik gene milta hai.

Aik gene ki sab copies aik jaisi hona zaroori nahi. Gene ki mukhtalif shaklein (alternative forms), jo mukhtalif khasiyatein deti hain, alleles kehlati hain. Jab aik hi allele wale do haploid gametes milte hain to bachche ko aik jaise alleles ka jora milta hai; aisa bachcha us khasiyat ke liye homozygous kehlata hai. Jab mukhtalif alleles wale do gametes milte hain to bachcha heterozygous hota hai.
Aaj hum jante hain ke gene 'DNA ka hissa, nucleotides ka aik silsila (sequence) hai jo aik polypeptide banane ka code deta hai'. Chromosome par gene ki khaas jagah ko us gene ka locus kehte hain.

Jab fard gametes banata hai to har gamete ko har gene ki sirf aik copy (allele) milti hai, aur yeh allele ittefaqan (randomly) chuna jata hai. Ise law of segregation (alag hone ka qanoon) kehte hain. Jab gametes milte hain to naya fard banta hai, aur us ka genotype unhi alleles se banta hai jo gametes mein the.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text:
Heterozygous fard mein sirf aik allele (dominant) zahir hota hai; doosra allele (recessive) maujood to hota hai lekin zahir nahi hota.
Kisi fard mein alleles ka milap us ka genotype hai. Phenotype woh khasiyat hai jo nazar aati hai. Yun samjhein: genotype naqsha (blueprint) hai aur phenotype us naqshe ka nazar aane wala nateeja.
Testcross se pata chalaya jata hai ke dominant phenotype wala fard homozygous hai ya heterozygous. Is mein dominant phenotype wale ko recessive phenotype wale se milaya jata hai. Misaal:

Gol beej wala paudha RR (homozygous) bhi ho sakta hai aur Rr (heterozygous) bhi, jab ke jhurridar beej wala paudha hamesha rr hota hai. Gol paude ka genotype maloom karne ke liye use jhurridar paude (rr) se milaya jata hai.

items: Agar woh RR hai to sab bachche gol (Rr) honge.
Agar woh Rr hai to bachche gol aur jhurridar 1:1 ratio mein honge.

blocks.title: Rozmarra ki misaal
blocks.text: Aik thaili sochiye jis mein do card hain, aik par R aur aik par r. Har walid aankh band kar ke apni thaili se aik card deta hai. Yahi ittefaqi intikhab segregation hai, aur isi liye Rr x Rr se har chaar mein se taqreeban aik bachcha rr hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Gol beej wale matar ka testcross (rr se) 52 gol aur 49 jhurridar bachche deta hai. Gol paude ka genotype kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Rr. rr ke saath testcross mein taqreeban 1:1 gol aur jhurridar sirf tab aate hain jab gol walid heterozygous ho. RR walid sirf gol (Rr) bachche deta.

items: Har fard ke paas har khasiyat ke do genes (alleles) hote hain; gamete ko sirf aik milta hai: law of segregation.
Aik jaise alleles: homozygous (RR, rr); mukhtalif alleles: heterozygous (Rr).
Gene: DNA par nucleotides ka silsila jo polypeptide ka code deta hai; locus: chromosome par gene ki jagah.
Testcross (rr ke saath): sab gol to RR; gol aur jhurridar 1:1 to Rr.
